test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact map, bounded persistent event, proven injector clear, correct B2CMI1/bit0/extlog attribution and recovery. Wrong channel, uncleared injector, fatal escape, missing evidence or recovery failure fails/blocks.

expected_evidence: Post-go ddr4chnlfailed bit0 plus extlog correlation
test_case.recovery: On failed disarm, wrong channel or hang, preserve evidence and use approved OOB recovery; ensure injector is cleared through vendor procedure before any reboot, then restore ARM/TAD/debug settings and validate memory topology.
